# linlan-xiaolan — 览生活 / 小览生活全栈工程

> Spring Boot 服务端（xiaolan-backend）+ uni-app x 移动端（mini），覆盖官网内容、记账本、心愿、提醒与微信登录。

Key capabilities:
- 官网内容接口：新闻、服务、解决方案、联系
- 小览生活：记账本、分类、心愿、提醒、心情记录
- 微信：公众号、小程序、开放平台登录
- 平台状态监控接口
- 移动端：uni-app x（UVue + UTS），首页 / 记账本 / 我的

Tech stack: Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Security, MyBatis, Druid, EFRAME 1.2.1, uni-app x (UTS), 45 uni_modules
Version: backend 1.2.2, mini 0.0.1
Repository: https://github.com/linlannet/linlan-xiaolan

Build / Test:
- Prerequisite: `cd ../linlan-eframe/backend && mvn clean install`
- Backend build: `cd backend && mvn clean install`
- Backend run:   `java -jar backend/target/xiaolan-backend.jar --spring.profiles.active=dev`
- Backend test:  `mvn test`
- Mobile: open `mini/` with HBuilderX; no npm scripts

Runtime:
- Default profile: `prod`
- Dev:  port 8081, context `/xiaolan_backend`
- Prod: port 8310, context `/xiaolan_backend`
- Primary DB:   `basedb_1.0`
- Secondary DB: `xiaolandb_1.0` (disabled by default)
- Mobile API:   `https://linlan.net/xiaolan_backend` (`mini/config/index.uts`)

Backend map:
- backend/src/main/java/net/linlan/www/comm        website content
- backend/src/main/java/net/linlan/xiaolan/comm    categories, bookkeeping
- backend/src/main/java/net/linlan/xiaolan/my      BookInfo, MindRecord, CheckRecord, WishInfo
- backend/src/main/java/net/linlan/manage/wechat   WeChat integrations
- backend/src/main/java/net/linlan/stage           security, status monitor
- backend/src/main/resources/mapper               MyBatis XML
- backend/scripts/sql                             database scripts
- backend/scripts/codestyle                       code style

Mobile map:
- mini/pages/tabbar                               home, finance, my
- mini/api/modules                                commBook, finance, platform, user, wxmini
- mini/utils                                      request, login
- mini/store                                      state
- mini/config/index.uts                           API URL, timeout, storage keys
- mini/uni_modules                                45 native modules
- mini/doc/plat-xiaolan.html(.md)                 API docs

Docs:
